column1: # The deterministic review target for the independent source audit.
# Built by the correction lane of 2026-08-27; see
# guidance/scripture-chronology.md and PROJECT-WORK.md for the audit scope.
# One row per FACTUAL CLAIM - a subject plus the index of one of its dates -
# never per binding, so a claim reused by a thousand verses is reviewed once.
# SELECTION RULE, reproducible from this header and the corpus AS AUDITED.
# The corpus it selects from is the one at commit 2330d63a5, which is the
# commit the cold audit reviewed. Later lanes withdrew claims and changed
# dispositions, so the rule does not reproduce against a later HEAD, and a
# reviewer regenerating this list must read the corpus at that commit:
#   pool = every authored claim (458 at that commit) MINUS the
#     complete-inspection set below. The exclusion needed to reproduce this
#     file is exactly: precision == 'duration', OR the claim's subject carries
#     a `relation: historical-setting` binding whose scope is a Psalm in
#     bindings.yaml, OR a non-null `derivation`, OR a unit scope naming a
#     non-vulgate system. That removes 57 claims and leaves a pool of 401.
#   within a stratum, order by sha256(seed + id), then round-robin the
#   strata in sorted order until 72 claims are taken.
#   Relative-precision claims are NOT excluded: 12 of the 72 rows below are
#   `relative`, so "high-risk classes" must never be read as the whole
# COMPLETE-INSPECTION SET, 57 claims, excluded from the sample because they
# are inspected completely rather than sampled. Each class is an executable
# predicate over the tracked corpus, and none of its members appears below:
#    9  the subject carries a `relation: historical-setting` binding on a
#       Psalm scope in bindings.yaml - Ps.30, Ps.62 and Ps.70, Ps.88,
#    1  a unit whose scope names a non-vulgate `system` (the Greek
#   The four class sizes total 59, not 57, because two claims belong to two
#   `duration` claims AND Psalm historical-settings. The union is 57 distinct
#   claims, which is the figure PROJECT-WORK.md states.
# Nothing here was hand-picked. A reviewer can regenerate the identical
# list, which is the point: a sample an author could steer is not a sample.
